name: zclass_camera_build_frustum_grid_tiles
description: zClass_Camera::BuildFrustumGridTiles builds clamped in-world frustum grid rings from the camera footprint.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because dense x87 min/max tests and diamond-ring tile writes still render with HLIL artifacts.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera frustum-grid helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44c3c0 validates clearing all 50 tile rings, WorldToGridCoordsClamped origin/min/max conversions, camera footprint setup, min/max row swaps, clamping min/max rows and columns to the world grid, area-index filtering, frustum clip testing, diamond-ring indexing, and ring/tile writes.
The native camera frustum-grid smoke verifies a controlled two-by-two footprint produces the expected in-world tiles across rings 0, 1, and 2 with no position offsets.
